messages:
maria: Heads up — noticed a cost bump and a handful of inference pods stuck Pending. Digging in, I see non-GPU jobs running on the gpu-pool nodes.

raj: running a quick check: `kubectl get nodes -l nodepool=gpu-pool -o wide`

raj: confirmed: 3 nodes created by launch-template v2.1 are missing the expected taint. I expected `redwood.com/gpu=true:NoSchedule` but it's absent on those nodes.

ops-bot: autoscaler: Created 3 nodes (launch-template v2.1) in us-west-2/gpu-pool at 2026-03-18T10:02:00Z

tim: that would explain the scheduling drift. CA launched nodes without the taint so generic workloads went on expensive GPU machines.

kevin: ouch. quick mitigation plan?

tim: short term: taint the nodes manually and then drain non-critical pods. commands: `kubectl taint nodes <node> redwood.com/gpu=true:NoSchedule` and then `kubectl drain <node> --ignore-daemonsets --delete-local-data --grace-period=60`.

kevin: manual taint + drain sounds risky during peak inference, might evict live traffic.

raj: safer path: patch the launch template (restore the bootstrap step that applies taint), cordon affected nodes, then delete them so ASG/CA recreates with correct userdata. That avoids mass eviction.

maria: can someone confirm what in v2.1 removed the taint? was it missing userdata or an overwritten bootstrap script?

raj: found it — v2.1's userdata omitted the cloud-init snippet that ran the `kubectl taint` during bootstrap. looks like a release slipped in an outdated template.

sre-oncall: opened INC-2026-115 (https://redwood.atlassian.net/browse/INC-2026-115) — tracking template rollback and node replacement. assigned to @raj and @kevin.

tim: long-term fix: add a validation policy (Gatekeeper/OPA) that enforces nodes with label `nodepool=gpu-pool` must have the taint `redwood.com/gpu=true:NoSchedule`. Also add a unit test for autoscaler scale events that asserts taint presence.

maria: agree. add a runbook section for verifying taints after scale-up and an alert if gpu-pool nodes have <100% taint coverage.

kevin: patched template now, cordoned one node and draining gracefully. applying `kubectl taint` to the two remaining nodes as a temporary stopgap.

maria: great — please open PRs for the template bump and the runbook changes. :thumbsup:

raj: filing PRs and will link in INC-2026-115. tagging infra-oncall for visibility.

maria: thanks all — keeping this thread open until the incident ticket shows green. will reopen if anomalies continue.
